title: Start monitoring with camera permission and complete calibration
description: Verifies that a user can start camera monitoring, complete the guided calibration flow, and enter active monitoring with live safety state visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Begin the calibration flow
Complete the calibration phases
Start monitoring from the calibration success screen
Verify active monitoring is visible
Verify live metrics are displayed

title: Show the drowsiness alert overlay during monitoring
description: The monitoring user sees the alert overlay appear automatically when drowsiness is detected while monitoring is active.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Start monitoring with camera access enabled
Trigger a drowsiness condition through the monitoring interface
Verify the drowsiness alert overlay is visible

title: Monitoring starts with live safety metrics
description: This verifies that a browser user can start monitoring from the dashboard and see active live metrics and session statistics while monitoring is running.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Grant camera access when prompted
Start monitoring
Verify the monitoring state is active
Verify live fatigue metrics and session statistics are displayed

title: Acknowledge the drowsiness alert and resume monitoring
description: The monitoring user can acknowledge the drowsiness alert and return to the normal safety state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Start monitoring with camera access enabled
Trigger a drowsiness alarm through the monitoring interface
Acknowledge the alert
Verify the normal monitoring state is visible

title: Stop monitoring automatically when the tab is hidden
description: Verifies that active camera monitoring stops automatically when the page is hidden to protect safety state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Switch away from the tab
Verify monitoring stops automatically
Verify the safety state returns to inactive

title: Stop monitoring and return to inactive state
description: Verifies that a user can stop an active camera monitoring session and return the dashboard to an inactive safety state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Stop camera monitoring
Verify monitoring is inactive
Verify the camera is no longer active

title: Backend connection status is visible on the dashboard
description: This verifies that the dashboard shows the current WebSocket connection state in the header for a browser user.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the backend connection status is displayed
Verify the current safety state indicator is displayed

title: Live metrics update during monitoring
description: This verifies that while monitoring is active, the displayed fatigue metrics and session statistics continue updating over time.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Grant camera access when prompted
Start monitoring
Wait for the live metrics to update
Verify the fatigue chart is displayed with ongoing data
Verify session statistics are displayed and updating

title: Become a viewer when another detector is already active
description: Verifies that a second device joining an active session becomes a viewer instead of taking detector control.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Verify viewer mode is shown
Verify detector control is not assigned to this device

title: Connect Arduino with a serial port
description: The user can enter a serial port and connect to the Arduino successfully from the main dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the port field with a valid serial port value
Click the Arduino connection control
Verify a connection success message is visible

title: Connection state and safety state remain visible while monitoring
description: This verifies that the connection badge and safety state stay visible during an active monitoring session.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Grant camera access when prompted
Start monitoring
Verify the backend connection status is displayed
Verify the current safety state indicator is displayed

title: Skip calibration and continue with default threshold
description: Verifies that a user can skip the calibration wizard and proceed into monitoring using the default detection threshold.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Skip calibration
Verify monitoring continues without calibration
Verify a default calibration state is in use

title: Send a sound alarm test to connected hardware
description: After connecting the Arduino, the user can trigger the sound alarm test command and see the hardware test state update.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the port field with a valid serial port value
Click the Arduino connection control
Click the sound alarm test control
Verify the hardware alarm test output is visible

title: Safety state is reflected in the dashboard
description: This verifies that the dashboard shows the current safety state alongside the live monitoring metrics when monitoring is active.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Grant camera access when prompted
Start monitoring
Verify the safety state indicator is displayed
Verify live monitoring metrics are displayed

title: Send a vibration test to connected hardware
description: After connecting the Arduino, the user can trigger the vibration test command and see the vibration test state update.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the port field with a valid serial port value
Click the Arduino connection control
Click the vibration test control
Verify the hardware vibration test output is visible

title: Stop hardware output after a test command
description: After connecting the Arduino, the user can stop hardware output and return the device to an idle state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the port field with a valid serial port value
Click the Arduino connection control
Click the stop output control
Verify the hardware output stop state is visible

title: Collected ML samples can be trained into a model
description: This verifies that a user can collect enough labeled samples, start training, and see the model status update after training completes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Collect labeled samples until both classes have enough data
Start model training
Verify the model status is displayed as trained or updated
Verify the sample progress remains visible

title: Retry calibration after an initial failed attempt
description: Verifies that a user can retry the calibration flow after an unsuccessful attempt and still complete monitoring setup.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Begin the calibration flow
Trigger an incomplete calibration attempt
Retry calibration
Complete the calibration phases
Verify calibration completes successfully
Verify monitoring is ready to start

title: See a viewer session when another detector is active
description: A second device opening the dashboard while monitoring is already active becomes a viewer and sees synchronized safety status instead of detector controls.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the dashboard on a second device while a detector session is active
Verify a viewer session state is visible
Verify synchronized safety status is visible

title: Use the current calibration instead of recalibrating
description: Verifies that a returning user can keep an existing calibration and proceed directly into monitoring.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Keep the current calibration when prompted
Verify the existing calibration is reused
Verify monitoring becomes active

title: Open the calibration panel and change sensitivity presets
description: Verifies that a user can open the calibration panel and switch between detection sensitivity presets while monitoring.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Open the calibration panel
Select a different sensitivity preset
Verify the active sensitivity preset changes
Verify monitoring remains available

title: ML model status and drowsiness score are visible
description: This verifies that the dashboard shows the current ML model status, drowsiness score, and collected sample progress on load.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the ML model status is displayed
Verify the drowsiness score and sample progress are displayed

title: Connect Arduino without entering a port
description: The user can attempt hardware connection without a port value and see the connection result state in the interface.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Leave the port field empty
Click the Arduino connection control
Verify a connection result message is visible

title: Clear stored calibration from the calibration panel
description: Verifies that a user can remove stored calibration data from the calibration panel and return to an uncalibrated state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to start camera monitoring
Approve camera permission
Open the calibration panel
Clear the stored calibration
Verify calibration data is removed
Verify the dashboard reflects an uncalibrated state

title: Collected ML training data can be cleared
description: This verifies that a user can clear collected ML samples from the training panel and see the counts reset.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Collect labeled samples
Open the ML training controls
Clear the collected training data
Verify the sample counts are reset
Verify the training panel remains available

title: Monitoring reflects the offline connection state
description: This verifies that the dashboard shows an offline backend connection state clearly when the app is loaded without an active WebSocket connection.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the backend connection status is displayed as offline
Verify the safety state indicator is displayed

title: Page loads with all dashboard panels visible
description: Verifies that the SafeNap dashboard renders all main UI panels on initial page load without errors.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the page to fully load
Verify the header contains the SafeNap title
Verify the status gauge panel is visible
Verify the camera view panel is visible
Verify the calibration panel is visible in the sidebar
Verify the controls panel is visible in the sidebar

title: StatusGauge displays PERCLOS metric and state labels
description: Verifies that the status gauge panel shows the PERCLOS label, percentage value, and state indicators on load.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to render
Verify the PERCLOS label is displayed
Verify the percentage value is displayed
Verify Normal, Atencao, and Perigo state labels are visible

title: SessionStatsPanel shows all stat categories
description: Verifies that the session statistics panel displays Tempo ativo, Piscadas, EAR medio, and Avisos labels.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the session stats panel to render
Verify the Tempo ativo label is visible
Verify the Piscadas label is visible
Verify the EAR medio label is visible
Verify the Avisos label is visible

title: LiveChart shows empty state before monitoring
description: Verifies that the live chart displays the Aguardando dados empty state when no monitoring data is available.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the live chart panel to render
Verify the Aguardando dados text is displayed
Verify the chart legend shows EAR and PERCLOS labels

title: CalibrationPanel shows instructions when camera is off
description: Verifies that the calibration panel displays its description and a disabled Calibrar button when the camera is not active.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the calibration panel to render
Verify the calibration description text is visible
Verify the Calibrar button is present and disabled
Verify the sensitivity preset buttons are visible

title: Controls panel shows port input and hardware test buttons
description: Verifies that the controls panel displays the serial port input field and the three hardware test buttons.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the controls panel to render
Verify the port input field is visible with COM3 placeholder
Verify the Conectar button is visible
Verify the Alarme button is visible
Verify the Vibracao button is visible
Verify the Desligar button is visible

title: ML status card shows idle state on load
description: Verifies that the ML status card displays the idle model state when the page first loads.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the ML status card to render
Verify the Modelo ML label is visible
Verify the idle status badge is displayed

title: ML training card shows sample counts and controls
description: Verifies that the ML training card displays alert and drowsy sample counts, progress bar, and train button.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the ML training card to render
Verify the Treinamento ML label is visible
Verify the Alertas count is displayed
Verify the Sonolento count is displayed
Verify the progress bar is visible

title: Camera button shows correct initial state
description: Verifies that the camera start/stop button displays the correct label based on AI loading state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the camera view panel to render
Verify the camera button is present
Verify the button shows Carregando IA, Iniciar, or Tentar novamente text
Verify the Camera inativo empty state text is visible

title: Page does not show any JavaScript errors in console
description: Verifies that the SafeNap dashboard loads without any uncaught JavaScript errors or unhandled promise rejections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the page to fully load
Collect all console errors during page load
Verify no uncaught TypeError or ReferenceError was logged
Verify no unhandled promise rejection was logged

title: Dashboard is responsive on mobile viewport
description: Verifies that the dashboard layout adapts correctly when viewed on a mobile-sized viewport.

steps.description: Navigate to / with a mobile viewport (375x812)
Wait for the page to fully load
Verify the header is visible and not overflowing
Verify the main content panels are visible
Verify no horizontal scrollbar appears

title: Dark theme is applied by default
description: Verifies that the SafeNap dashboard uses a dark theme by default on initial load.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the page to fully load
Check the computed background color of the body
Verify the background is a dark color (low RGB values)

title: WebSocket reconnects after connection loss
description: Verifies that the WebSocket client attempts to reconnect when the backend connection is lost.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Observe the WebSocket connection status
Wait for reconnection attempts
Verify the connection status transitions through CONNECTING or RECONNECTING states

title: Port input field accepts text input
description: Verifies that the Arduino serial port input field accepts and displays typed text.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Locate the port input field
Type COM3 into the port field
Verify the input field value is COM3

title: Sensitivity preset buttons are clickable
description: Verifies that the three sensitivity preset buttons (Leve, Padrao, Alta) in the calibration panel are interactive.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the calibration panel to render
Click the Leve sensitivity button
Verify the Leve button has the active/primary style
Click the Alta sensitivity button
Verify the Alta button now has the active/primary style

title: ErrorBoundary catches component render errors
description: Verifies that the ErrorBoundary wrapper prevents a single component failure from crashing the entire application.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the page loads without any error boundary fallback UI being shown
Verify all main panels are rendered (no blank areas from ErrorBoundary catch)

title: API proxy forwards requests to backend
description: Verifies that the Vite dev server correctly proxies /api requests to the FastAPI backend on port 8000.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/config
Check the HTTP response status
Verify the response status is 200 (backend is reachable via proxy)
